data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to list and preview system ringtones, alarms and notifications on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to fetch lists of system ringtones, alarms and notification sounds, and to play or stop a preview of any selected sound natively. It uses Android’s RingtoneManager and iOS’s AVAudioPlayer under the hood.
use_when: You need to display or let users preview the device’s built‑in ringtones, alarms or notification sounds.
You want a lightweight solution with no runtime dependencies for simple sound enumeration and previewing.
You are targeting Android and iOS and need native playback without adding a full audio player package.
avoid_when: You need advanced audio playback features such as streaming, equalizer, or custom audio effects.
You require a completion callback or event stream for when a preview finishes.
You are building a cross‑platform app that also needs to record audio or stream from a remote source.
strengths: Zero runtime dependencies – no extra packages bundled.
Native preview playback with a single API call.
Simple, imperative API that works out of the box on Android and iOS.
Supports both Android and iOS with minimal platform‑specific code.
weaknesses: iOS system sound path is undocumented and may change between iOS versions.
No completion or progress callbacks for preview playback.
Only one sound can play at a time; no event stream for state changes.
